detail: Playwright (browser/21-chat-restart.spec.ts): picked Opus, sent a message with a scripted usage fill, restarted the server, reopened: selector shows Opus, pie aria-label unchanged, second launch has --resume fake-session-1 and the scripted reply shows. The fake agent cannot recall text, so 'same session' is checked by the resume argument.
Script: reply 2 writes 'No conversation found with session ID' and crashes. After a restart a new message got the answer from a third launch with no --resume; no 'not delivered' text; one send only.

Scripted multi-line error twice (not the dead-session text): werk started the agent one more time (2 launches), pane shows 'Your message was not delivered. Send it again.' and all three error lines; after a working agent and a resend the reply came from a launch with --resume fake-session-1.

Agent writes a 3-line 'Not logged in ... claude auth login' error and exits. One launch only (no retry) and all error lines show, but the pane shows 'Fix the problem above, then send it again.' instead of 'Your message was not delivered. Send it again.' (src/chat/crash-rules.ts fatal branch).

Selected Sonnet, started a long turn: the selector is disabled while the turn runs and keeps Sonnet; after the turn the switch works, no crash text, pie popover shows % and 'Clear context', clear works and the next message is answered. Failed only on the label: the option reads 'Sonnet + Opus advisor', not 'Sonnet with Opus advisor'. Note the default selection is 'Sonnet + Opus advisor', so I picked Sonnet first.

Two tabs opened on card A and card B; messages, replies and the ask stay in their own tab and the ask is answerable after switching. But the chips read 'main' and '2', not the titles 'Card A'/'Card B' (client/app/tab-strip.tsx shows the tab name), and the chip of the tab with an open ask has no yellow blink (only data-blink=red exists).

Switching to the second tab (80-paragraph log, new reply arrived while hidden) shows it scrolled to the bottom with the newest reply in view. But after scrolling the log to the top and a reply arriving, scrollTop jumped to the bottom (4770); chat-pane.tsx scrolls to the end on every state change.

Tab 1 agent crashed twice (original plus one retry) while tab 2 was shown: chip 1 blinks red, tab 2 shows one dead line with the first error line (and the tab name), tab 1 shows the whole error; a new message started a new agent that replied, the red blink stopped and the line left tab 2. The tab is named 'main'/'2' by the product.
Switched model to Opus after a reply: no chip blinks red, no dead line in any tab, next message got the scripted reply.

Scripted background_tasks events: one task shows the 'A background agent runs' line, an empty list removes it; reply ending 'Next: say "merge it"' shows a 'merge it' button, clicking sends it as a user turn, the agent replies and the button goes. 'Tab counts as running' has no visible or DOM signal, so it was not checked.
